Name: (AT) Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings Shipping Bin by erasercat
Author: lianace
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3833]This mod was originally made[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66341516]erasercat[/url] to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]strawberrymilk95[/url]. Erasercat has since left the Stardew modding community and their mods are abandoned. They have given permission for people to update their mods as long as credit is given. I simply converted the mod to work with Alternative Textures.

This mod includes two versions, a basic one that looks the same no matter the season, and one seasonal version that changes with the seasons in game.

If you are looking for a CP version of this mod (that is a standard replacement), check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21374]chiccenSDV's update of the mod here[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22350/][size=5]I have also converted Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings for AT.[/size][/url]
